description:
The Bertelsmann Stiftung is an independent foundation headquartered in the northern German town of Gütersloh. The Washington, DC-based Bertelsmann Foundation is part of the Stiftung’s international network.

The Bertelsmann Stiftung was founded in 1977 by Reinhard Mohn. Through its projects, studies, and events, the foundation stimulates public debate and provides impetus for social change. Serving the public good and creating sustainable impact are the fundamental principles that guide its work. Its initiatives not only develop practical solutions but also provide empirically grounded insights and recommendations for policymakers, practitioners, and the broader public.

At present, the Bertelsmann Stiftung Executive Board consists of Dr. Brigitte Mohn, Prof. Dr. Andreas Pinkwart, and Wilhelm-Friedrich Uhr.
